description: This file defines a Flutter state management class 'WhiteboardProvider' used to manage a list of whiteboard strokes, including methods to add strokes and clear the whiteboard, with notification support.

classes.name: WhiteboardProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-class that manages the list of strokes on a whiteboard, providing methods to add and clear strokes.

methods.name: addStroke
methods.description: Adds a new stroke to the list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all strokes from the whiteboard and notifies listeners.
